query_provenance.author: AI assistant proposal (v0.4); revisions AI-suggested and accepted by the team reviewer
query_provenance.design: 4 queries per ingestion topic (11 topics); 2 dev and 2 test per topic; specific research questions, not topic names
query_provenance.revisions: 6 queries edited or replaced (original_query/revision_note). Two v0.4.1 replacements were swapped in v0.5 after a keyword corpus-support check found <=1 matching paper (V2-04-4, V2-11-4). Keyword matches for the other checked queries: membership inference/model inversion ~37, entity resolution 17, EHR 412, SDN traffic engineering 51, kernel isolation 12, RTOS 7. Not every query was checked; pooling reports per-query relevant counts.
query_provenance.instructions: Frozen for pooling. Do not edit queries after pooling starts. Do not tune on test queries. Pool with a fresh directory via refresh_retrieval prepare --benchmark.
